purpose: Development examples used to design and inspect directional Navarro-to-VLB spelling-retrieval priors. This file is not an evaluation benchmark, does not estimate accuracy, and does not confer editorial review status.

primary_sources.author: Eduardo de Almeida Navarro
primary_sources.title: Transcrição e tradução integral anotada das cartas dos índios Camarões, escritas em 1645 em tupi antigo
primary_sources.section: CRITÉRIOS PARA A TRANSCRIÇÃO PALEOGRÁFICA, items a,c,e,f,i; printed pp.7–8
primary_sources.scope_note: Primary explanation of Navarro’s modern transcription conventions and historical spelling variability in another seventeenth-century corpus. It motivates priors, not universal VLB substitutions.

primary_sources.author: Carlos Drumond; transcription by Emerson José Silveira da Costa
primary_sources.title: Vocabulário na Língua Brasílica — Advertência necessária
primary_sources.scope_note: Second edition incorporates and corrects material from distinct manuscripts while preserving original orthography of added Lisbon entries; do not assume a single uniform VLB spelling system.

recommended_priors.limit: Keep y and i distinct; never delete arbitrary g.
Keep intact alternatives and a nonzero cost; historical î does not establish modern y=î.
Common before historical a,o,u and word end; c can instead encode s before e/i.
Condition on following historical i/e, including historical î corresponding to modern y.
c candidate normally before historical e/i; preserve original s and avoid globally equating c/k/s.
A competing representation, not permission to strip all diacritics or merge modern i/y/î.
Do not generalize to arbitrary u/o interchange.
Modern glottal distinction remains part of lexical identity.
Single demonstrated local pair; never strip nasalization freely or treat nasal consonants as interchangeable.

recommended_priors.modern: lexeme plus explicitly attested surface morphology
historical: ai-/a-/xe- attachments; nominal/adjectival stem alternants; relational r-/s-
recommended_priors.limit: Do not train these differences as generic insertions/deletions.

usage.selection: Purposively selected for spelling and morphology contrasts, not sampled for corpus-wide estimates.
usage.training_note: These examples informed the proposed priors; do not report performance on them as held-out evaluation.
usage.review_scope: Assistant visual inspection confirms the recorded printed forms and supports the stated candidate comparisons. It does not certify all citation occurrences or complete coverage of any paragraph.
usage.existing_review_note: Two anchors identify previously recorded assistant-reviewed citation/form associations. Their status comes from vlb/source/verified_citation_associations.json and is not newly assigned by this evidence file.
